sections.decision: Use Original version, normalized Airbus holder, and the printed supersedure statement. No visual lifecycle stamp appears, so lifecycle remains unknown.
Use source dates, A380/EASA.A.110 identity and normalized subject without the ATA prefix; normalize ATA 57 title to Wings.
Keep the all-MSN A380 group and an installed-flap group containing the exact 130 unique Appendix serials. Preserve TB2101 removal and the table evidence, including RH TB1056's revised date.
Retain the explicit serviceable-flap and transfer-of-title starting-date definitions, using full native-text evidence for Note 3 and the Appendix footnote.
Keep wrong-alloy manufacture, reduced structural integrity and the stated identification/SDI/replacement mitigation; treat SB-list corrections as revision history, not a new unsafe-condition cause.

Use five atomic requirements: identify, table-triggered one-time SDI, contact, delegated-timing replacement and ongoing conditional installation. Preserve 7 years/4,300 FC whichever first from each row-specific date.
Capture the printed unless-accomplished-previously blanket for one-time actions; do not use it to erase the ongoing installation condition.
No discrete previous-action-credit clause is present; keep an empty array.
Retain original and Revision 1 of Airbus SB A380-57-8111 with exact dates and later-approved-revision allowance.
Keep only the explicit supersedes and retains-requirements-of candidate edges to selected AD 2016-0095, resolve its record/logical key, and leave manually_verified=false.
Retain the EASA AMOC authority, EASA regulatory contact and Airbus A380 technical contact exactly from Remarks.
Classify A380, ATA 57, mixed frequency and table-driven compliance; preserve the frozen near-duplicate cluster and keep human_confirmed=false.

overall_rationale: Source-grounded third-machine reconciliation of frozen A/B submissions; the candidate remains unreviewed and must be independently confirmed by a human before it can enter the gold set.
